title: [Change Log] Preserve SystemId for unloaded record modifications
summary: Change Log Management now preserves the SystemId from persisted records when modifications are recorded without the record being loaded first, fixing incorrect null SystemId values in change entries.
key_points: When an incoming modification has a null SystemId, Change Log uses the persisted record it already loaded
No extra database read; the populated-SystemId path and public signatures stay unchanged
Fixes Changed Record SystemId on modification entries
Change Log entries for failed inserts are a separate platform issue and are not addressed
Adds a regression test for modifying a record by primary key without loading it first
